reason: The typing grind is real, but I've read a hundred AI openers and they all sound the same, and prospects spot it. There are no customer results and it's my own $147 on a $60k salary, so I'm not putting a card down on a promise.
objection: AI-written DMs sound robotic and prospects can tell. If it burns through my client's leads with openers that read like a template, that's on me, and nobody has shown me it works.
would_change_my_mind: Real sample DMs written from real profiles that I can't tell from my own, plus a few SDRs or agency owners showing reply and booked-call numbers. A trial with no card up front would also help.
